_comment: OPTIONAL read-only server inspection. Copy to config/server_inspection.json on the
phone and set enabled=true ONLY if you have deliberately provisioned a credential for
this device. It is absent by default, and while it is absent the noon job reports
PASS_PUBLIC_HEALTHY_SERVER_INSPECTION_UNAVAILABLE and inspects the public page only.
Nothing here can widen what the job may do. The complete set of remote commands is
fixed in SERVER_READ_ONLY_COMMANDS in front_page_cache_monitor.py: wp option get,
wp cron event list, test, realpath, readlink, stat, sha256sum. The 'path' and
'option' values are validated against strict patterns before they are quoted into a
template, and no other remote string is ever handed to ssh.
Never point this at a credential that can write. A read-only account is the right
shape for this job. Never commit config/server_inspection.json — .gitignore excludes it.
